svg.title: Sarthi Kalyan — Multi-Agent Rag Assistant
svg.desc: Sarthi Kalyan: Multi-agent system matching citizens to 750+ government welfare schemes with dual-mode retrieval, deployed on Google Cloud with WhatsApp and web interfaces. 750+ schemes; Top 7% XPRIZE global; Finalist CraftNCode. Recognition: Top 100 / 1,400+ · Xprize. Tech: LangGraph, Gemini, FastAPI, Next.js, BigQuery.
